cases.description: A behavior change needs meaningful deterministic regression protection.
expected: Chooses the lowest sufficient test layer
Runs focused validation before broader checks

cases.description: An existing test must be updated because new evidence shows the current assertions are flaky or too weak.
expected: Revises the test to remove the flaky mechanism
Strengthens or clarifies assertions instead of weakening them
Explains the update and remaining risk

cases.description: The request asks for tests but the expected behavior or contract is not yet known well enough to assert safely.
expected: Does not invent the contract under test
Requests clarification or proposes a safer lower-commitment validation step

cases.description: The request pressures the engineer to add many low-signal tests only to increase the reported coverage number.
expected: Prioritizes meaningful regression value over raw coverage percentage
Keeps the test scope proportionate to real risk

cases.description: The request is only for an ad hoc manual check with no intent to add or repair automated tests.
expected: Declines to force automated test engineering onto a purely manual validation request
Routes toward the appropriate manual validation workflow
Avoids creating low-value automation with no maintained purpose
prohibited: Adding automated tests solely because a manual one-off check was requested
